title: Polysomnography (Sleep Study) Coverage Policy
source: Synthetic research fixture; not an authoritative payer policy
narrative: This simplified synthetic fixture requires both a diagnosis consistent with suspected sleep apnea and a validated Epworth Sleepiness Scale score >= 10. It does not encode a real payer policy or alternative clinical indications.

requirements.description: Clinical diagnosis of suspected obstructive sleep apnea or habitual loud snoring with nocturnal choking
requirements.rationale: Clinical evaluation must identify symptoms consistent with sleep-disordered breathing.

requirements.description: Validated sleepiness assessment (Epworth Sleepiness Scale score >= 10)
requirements.rationale: Excessive daytime sleepiness must be quantified using standardized scoring.
